title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Add data fields to report layouts using Word add-in (new data picker)
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 introduces a new data picker task pane in the Word add-in that simplifies adding data fields, repeaters, and items to report layouts through a tree structure interface instead of direct XML editing. This feature improves report creation productivity and reduces errors for layout authors.
key_points: New task pane in Word add-in enables intuitive insertion of data items, repeaters, and fields with a collapsible tree view
Tooltips and metadata display help users navigate fields accurately and reduce errors during layout design
Updated report Word layout XML now includes 'Obsolete State' attribute for Report Column and DataItem elements
Data picker is available only in Word desktop version, not Word Online, due to missing features like content controls
features: Word add-in data picker task pane
tree structure view for data navigation

quotes.text: The tree structure view allows users to easily navigate and manage data, captions, and metadata.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains how the new interface improves usability compared to direct XML editing for report creators

quotes.text: The Word add-in task pane lets you insert data items, repeaters, and fields directly into your layout document.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the core functionality that streamlines report layout creation workflows
